checks.name: Language-neutral fixtures decode and round-trip through the runtime contract
Continuous backlog keeps only the newest frame
Beats survive intervening snapshots, drain independently and are not replayed to new readers
Duplicate, old, future and unreliable beats cannot enqueue pulses
Beat queue is bounded and ages by the detected pulse timestamp
Silence, transport loss, format change and reconnection clear queued beat pulses
Onset backlog is ordered and capped at 64 newest events
Events expire after 250ms; continuous state reports its age
Interval flux peak survives a quieter latest snapshot and more than 64 frames
Readers drain independently and new readers never replay old bursts
Silent frames cannot enqueue onsets or flux effects
Reconnect clears old data, rejects late callbacks, and restarts sequence numbers
Diagnostic tap records every frame independently of display reads and stays bounded
Concurrent publication and reads remain coherent and keep the event bound
Registry switches sessions, drops pending bursts, and leaves the source generation intact
Same or unknown module selection preserves the current session and its pending events
Pause drops hidden-time events on resume and forwards the new viewport
